item.title: How to get help in Windows - Microsoft Support
item.description: Here are a few different ways to find help for Windows Search for help - Enter a question or keywords in the search box on the taskbar to find apps, files, settings, and get help from the web.

item.title: About Get Help | Microsoft Support
item.description: The Windows Get Help app is a centralized hub for accessing a wide range of resources, including tutorials, FAQs, community forums, and direct assistance from Microsoft support personnel. Whether users encounter technical issues, have questions about Windows features, or seek guidance on how to perform specific tasks, Get Help aims to streamline the process of finding solutions and enhancing ...

item.title: Enable or Disable Tips and Suggestions Notifications in Windows 11
item.description: This tutorial will show you how to enable or disable "Get tips and suggestions when using Windows" notifications for your account or all users in Windows 11. You may get notifications for tips and suggestions when using Windows by default.

item.title: Open File Explorer in Windows 11 | Windows 11 Forum
item.description: This tutorial will show you different ways to open File Explorer in Windows 11. File Explorer ("C:\Windows\explorer.exe") in Windows 11 helps you get the files you need quickly and easily.

item.title: ヘルプについて | Microsoft Support
item.description: Get Helpで問題を検索する方法 Windows 問い合わせアプリは、チュートリアル、FAQ、コミュニティ フォーラム、Microsoft サポート担当者からの直接のサポートなど、幅広いリソースにアクセスするための一元的なハブです。

item.title: Informationen zu Hilfe | Microsoft Support
item.description: Wie sehe ich die Ergebnisse des Copilot-Problembehandlers? Wie suche ich nach meinem Problem in Get Help? Die Windows-Hilfe-App ist ein zentraler Ausgangspunkt für den Zugriff auf eine Vielzahl von Ressourcen, einschließlich Lernprogrammen, häufig gestellten Fragen, Communityforen und direkter Unterstützung durch Microsoft-Supportmitarbeiter.

item.title: Como obter ajuda no Windows - Suporte da Microsoft
item.description: Aqui estão algumas maneiras diferentes de localizar ajuda para o Windows Procurar ajuda – Insira uma pergunta ou palavra-chave na caixa de pesquisa na barra de tarefas para encontrar apps, arquivos, configurações e obtenha ajuda da Web.

item.title: Hulp vragen in Windows - Microsoft Ondersteuning
item.description: Hier vindt u enkele verschillende manieren om te zoeken naar hulp voor Windows 10: Zoeken naar Help: typ een vraag of trefwoorden in het zoekvak op de taakbalk om apps, bestanden of instellingen te zoeken en om online help te krijgen.

item.title: 關於 [取得說明] | Microsoft Support
item.description: Windows 取得協助應用程式是存取各種資源的集中式中樞，包括教學課程、常見問題集、社群論壇，以及來自 Microsoft 支援人員的直接協助。 無論使用者遇到技術問題、對 Windows 功能有疑問，還是尋求有關如何執行特定工作的指導， [取得協助] 都旨在簡化尋找解決方案的過程並增強整體使用者體驗 ...

item.title: Cum să obțineți ajutor în Windows - Asistență Microsoft
item.description: Iată câteva modalități diferite de a găsi ajutor pentru Windows Căutați ajutor: introduceți o întrebare sau cuvinte cheie în caseta de căutare de pe bara de activități pentru a găsi aplicații, fișiere, setări și ajutor de pe web.
